pages.text: Stars filled the summer night sky. Tonight, they said, shooting stars would fall.
"I really want to see a shooting star!" Dodo and Mumu spread a blanket on the hill.
Dodo cleared her throat. "Shooting stars only fall at midnight. Close your eyes until then. I know!"
Dodo shut her eyes tight. "Don't open them now. One, two, three..."
Just then, whoosh! A shooting star passed before Mumu. "There it goes!"
"What? Where?" Dodo opened her eyes wide. Only ordinary stars filled the sky.
She shut her eyes tight again. "This time I'll really wait until midnight." The shooting stars were quiet.
Mumu kept his mouth shut and watched the sky. He didn't even blink.
Whoosh! A long shooting star crossed the sky. "Saw it! Dodo, now!"
This time Dodo saw it with open eyes too! "Saw it! ...And your star must have heard my wish too." Under the blanket, they giggled.
